description: getMailDnsRecords: Get the DNS records a mail domain needs (MX, SPF, DKIM, ...), for customers managing DNS externally. Requires authentication.

domain.description: A mail-enabled domain from listMailDomains, e.g. 'example.com'.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

name: getMailDnsRecords
